contradictions.detail: The listing says 17-inch Cayman II wheels (matching photos). The commenter-posted vinanalytics build sheet lists option 408, 18-inch Boxster S II wheels. The original wheels appear to have been swapped; whether the originals come with the car is unstated.

critical_evidence.evidence: The car is a manual, so clutch/DMF work applies. A commenter reports the Carfax shows a clutch assembly replaced at 15,333 mi in 2014, within the last 40k miles. No invoice or reason for such an early replacement has been provided.
A commenter asked for a borescope or compression test. The seller replied only that 2011 cars 'do not suffer from bore scoring'. No images or leakdown sheet were provided.
The seller commented 'PERFECT DME REPORT' with 987 operating hours. Overrev ranges 1-6 and readiness monitors were not seen here.

The underside photo shows factory-style headers feeding catalytic converters on both banks, with no aftermarket units apparent. Surface corrosion is visible on the housings. Confirm the CA emissions label and readiness at PPI.

A commenter says the Carfax shows unspecified cooling-system work at PA Euros in Feb 2026. No invoice has been posted, water pump/thermostat replacement is unconfirmed, and there are no photos of the front radiators with ducts removed.

No coilovers or chassis modifications are disclosed and the photos show a factory-looking stance. The only disclosed drivetrain mod is a short shifter, which is not a suspension item. Damper and bushing condition still belong in the PPI.

documentation.rationale: The identity/terms half is solid: VIN, clean-title claim, Carfax snapshot with 23 service records and two owners, paint-meter photos and cold-start/imperfection videos. The maintenance half is only Carfax lines relayed by a commenter; no invoices are posted despite requests. Overrev data, borescope and cooling receipts are all absent.

condition.rationale: Low mileage, and exterior and cabin photos look clean. Against that, the underside photo shows corrosion on the exhaust, shields and fasteners that commenters dispute is merely surface. All-season tires hint at winter use. The early 15k-mile clutch replacement and a Feb 2026 cooling/axle-seal visit are unexplained. Nothing is proven either way on mechanicals.

price_value.rationale: The supplied fair-value estimate is built from Cayman S sales and overstates a base 2.9 car. Against base-manual reality, the current $25,000 bid is below where these typically hammer, but the final price is unknown. The disputed corrosion and missing records temper value.

mission_fit.rationale: A manual, DFI 987.2 with a real point of view that is easy to resell in 6-24 months fits the enthusiast bridge brief well. The base trim and the likely hammer sitting above the ideal band keep it from a decisive fit.

logistics.rationale: Douglassville, PA is far from Carmel. The dealer welcomes a PPI, but the auction closes Saturday and the shop is weekday-only, the sale is not inspection-contingent, and payment is a 3-day wire. An out-of-state car must pass CA smog.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: The six-speed manual is the genuinely desirable trait. Base 2.9 trim, the most common black-over-black combination, and no Sport Chrono, PASM or LSD make it a typical example rather than a standout.

ppi_focus: Panels-off underbody corrosion assessment: subframe and control-arm bolts, brake and fuel lines, rear axle area, exhaust fasteners.
Front radiators, condensers and duct mounts for corrosion and debris; coolant tank seam and water pump weep hole.
Independent DME overrev read (ranges 1-6) and full code and readiness scan.
Borescope of all six cylinders plus leakdown.
Clutch engagement point, slip test and DMF rattle at idle, given the early clutch replacement.
Axle seal and rear main seal/AOS for leaks after the Feb 2026 axle-seal work; cold-start smoke.
Short shifter installation quality, shift cables and bushings.
Dampers, top mounts, toe links and lower control arm bushings, plus alignment readings.
Tire DOT dates and wear pattern; brake rotor and pad condition.
CA emissions label present under the hood or on the rear lid.
what_would_change_verdict: Clean overrev ranges, a clean borescope/leakdown and a PPI finding only surface corrosion would substantially strengthen the case.
An invoice showing the Feb 2026 cooling work included the water pump and thermostat would retire the biggest age-related item.
Panels-off photos showing structural corrosion, seized or rotted fasteners, or rotted lines would move it down sharply.
An unexplained or abuse-related 2014 clutch replacement, or overrev hits in ranges 3+, would move it down.
Inability to complete any inspection before the close would count against it.
evidence.mission_note: A manual 987.2 is a genuine enthusiast bridge with easy resale. It serves the brief only if the corrosion and early-clutch questions are answered, because accelerated_bridge mode does not justify bidding blind on a non-contingent remote auction.
evidence.rationale: This listing establishes identity well: VIN-decoded 2011 base Cayman 2.9, six-speed manual, ~33k miles consistent with a Carfax last reading of 32,657, two reported owners, and a claimed clean PA title with no reported accidents. Observed issues are underbody corrosion visible in the underside photo and conceded by the seller as 'surface', all-season CrossClimate 2 tires suggesting winter use, and an aftermarket short shifter. A commenter's reading of the Carfax adds a clutch replacement at 15,333 mi and a Feb 2026 visit for axle seals and cooling work shortly before a brief second ownership ended. None of these carry an invoice. Model-critical evidence is thin: the DME overrev report is only asserted as 'perfect', there is no borescope or leakdown, and cooling receipts and radiator photos are absent. The OE-style catalytic converters visible underneath support California smog feasibility. The supplied fair-value range derives from Cayman S sales and does not reflect a base 2.9 car.
evidence.next_action: Today, message the seller for the full Carfax PDF, the Feb 2026 PA Euros invoice, overrev range screenshots and panels-off underbody photos. In parallel, book a same-day Lemon Squad or Porsche-independent PPI with borescope in Douglassville before the Saturday close, and set the bid cap only from the cost engine's output.
